label: Writes that happen once: idempotency keys, row versions, send-once, signed rows

params.name: header
params.label: The request header a caller puts its idempotency key in

params.name: body_key
params.label: ...or this key in the JSON body

params.name: key_max
params.label: An idempotency key is cut to this many letters

params.name: ttl_seconds
params.label: A repeated POST with the same key within this many seconds gets the first answer and makes no second effect

params.name: answers_file
params.label: The data file (owner-only) that keeps each key's first answer while it lives

params.name: answers_most
params.label: At most this many kept answers; the oldest go first

params.name: lock_stripes
params.label: How many locks keys are spread over (two requests with one key never run at once)

params.name: version_field
params.label: The field a row's version is kept in; a write naming an older version is refused (409)

params.name: version_body_key
params.label: The body key a caller sends the version it read in

params.name: sent_file
params.label: The data file that remembers each message sent once (kind + key, hashed)

params.name: sent_keep_days
params.label: A send-once mark is forgotten after this many days

params.name: signed_hash_field
params.label: A row holding this field is SIGNED: sha256 of its signed fields

params.name: signed_fields_field
params.label: ...and this field lists which of its fields the signature covers

params.name: id_field
params.label: A signed row is known by this field (else by its place in the file)
